story.title: How Grill started
paragraphs: Welcome to the tastiest grill website. Our dishes are prepared only from fresh local meat, and our skilled couriers deliver quickly and bring your order hot.
Grill.am is one of the longest-running, tastiest food chains in the Armenian market, preparing meals from premium meat products.
Since May 20, 2013, we have been operating under the name grill.am, which is also our website address.
We assure you that you will find the fastest and most delicious prepared dishes on our menu.

items.body: On May 20, our journey began under the name grill.am.
We opened new branches across the city so grill flavor is available in different corners of Yerevan.

items.title: 10+ locations
items.body: Today we have more than 10 locations, a strong reputation, and hot, delicious delivery across many parts of the city.
